content_blocks.label: clause_1._EXECUTION
content_blocks.text: I, Evelyn Q. Hartley, of Maplewood, State of Verano, do hereby execute this Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: My entire estate shall be distributed equally among my three children: Jonathan Hartley, Victoria Hartley, and William Hartley.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._GUARDIANSHIP
content_blocks.text: In the event of my death, I appoint Jonathan Hartley as the guardian of my minor child, Victoria Hartley.
